excerpt: Non-accelerator experiments have become increasingly important in particle physics and astrophysics. From them comes the evidence of physics beyond the SM, with the discovery of neutrino oscillations and adiabatic flavor conversion.
publisher: Particle Data Group (F. Takahashi et al.), Int. J. Mod. Phys. A 41, 2630011 (2026)
title: Review of Particle Physics 2026, §36: Particle Detectors for Non-Accelerator Physics
